model.name: free-intercept log-linear growth
model.formula: log10(parasites/mL) = a + b * time_days, with Normal(0, sigma^2) error on the log10 scale
model.observation_model: Normal distribution on log10-transformed densities with constant variance sigma^2. Measurements below 10 parasites/mL are left-censored: likelihood contribution Phi((log10(10) - mu) / sigma).

diagnostics.baseline_comparison: A logistic growth model (Delta_AICc = +7.2) does not improve on the free-intercept log-linear baseline: its carrying capacity (K ~ 921131643 parasites/mL, t_half ~ 26.0 d) is poorly identified, and the extra parameter is not supported by the data. Residuals show no systematic departure from log-linearity (lag-1 autocorrelation = -0.461, Shapiro-Wilk p = 0.125).
